items.source_en:
Omar Nevin here, with the best news you've heard all day! Chandra Vineyards overstocked my hull, so I have wine to sell for cheap. Classy stuff, too. Good enough for Alderaan Luxury. 

I'll keep my overstock set aside for travelers like us. We work hard, we all deserve to kick back and relax with a glass of merlot. Hit me up at any of the empire with terminals like these, or find me in Dantoo Town and let's make a trade. My ship's called "Gravitas". Give me a ring if you see me in the spacelanes. I'm always down to share a bottle with a fellow traveler. 

Cheers! 

Omar

건배!

오마르
